theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_no_infinite_planar_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : ℕ → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (z : ℕ → Euclid P) (ρ R : ℝ), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → 0 < ρ → (∀ i, Module.finrank ℝ (Q i) = 2) → (∀ i, z i ∈ Q i) → (∀ i, ‖z i‖ ≤ R) → (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint ((Q i : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (z i) ρ) ((Q j : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (z j) ρ)) → (∀ i, ∀ w ∈ (Q i : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (z i) ρ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball w ε → μHE[2] (W ∩ (Q i : Set (Euclid P))) ≤ C.massOn W) → False
